[EN] Mission Orders

The Stalker Company has proven a massive threat to the federation.

Destroy Stalker Company {@LinkCreature:32#7#reapers}, {@LinkCreature:32#8#destroyers}, {@LinkCreature:32#9#snipers}, and {@LinkCreature:32#12#templars}.

Report to Celion when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

La Stalker Company ha demostrado ser una gran amenaza para la federación.

Destruye a los {@LinkCreature:32#7#reapers}, {@LinkCreature:32#8#destroyers}, {@LinkCreature:32#9#snipers} y {@LinkCreature:32#12#templars} de la Stalker Company.

Preséntate ante Celion cuando completes la misión.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
